defects.summary: Renewing an already-reclaimed claim lets two agents hold the same work simultaneously.
defects.why: The design explicitly honours a renewal after another agent took over, which is a double-ownership bug, not a recovery.

defects.summary: The agent ignores the renewal response, so a rejected renewal is indistinguishable from a successful one.
defects.why: A silently failed renewal means the agent believes it holds a lease it has lost.

defects.summary: 'The feature works as expected under concurrent load' cannot be observed or refuted.
defects.why: No reviewer could tell whether this criterion was met.

defects.summary: TTL is cached per process, so an operator's change silently does not apply to running agents.
defects.why: The spec states the behaviour but does not acknowledge it as a limitation or an open question.
Named in the design with no mitigation.

defects.summary: 'Open questions: None' on a design with unresolved concurrency semantics.
defects.why: Claiming no open questions is itself a defect when the design leaves ownership ambiguous.
